breaking.change: Defaults to 0 (no contact foam). The band is now measured in water depth, is none at the contact line, and appears only where the water moves (its waves, ripples, wakes or current), as lace: still water touching a post or a floating body no longer draws a hard white ring.
breaking.fix: Set foamWidth (m of water depth, for example 0.35) on water that should foam against what stands in it.
